subject: ScaleWave Dedicated pool: recommended GPU mix, perf/$ curves & commit structure
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex@scalewave.ai>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood Dedicated - GPU mix/pricing for embeddings + low-latency chat

Jordan —

Quick intro: I'm Alex (CTO, ScaleWave). We're evaluating Redwood Dedicated for a mixed workload: nightly high-throughput embeddings (batch) and a low-latency chat product for customers (P99 target ~120ms). Current traffic today is small but grows quickly — expected steady state: ~600k tokens/day for chat, ~4B tokens/day for embeddings (batch jobs).

Two asks before a call: 1) recommended pool shape (A100/H100/L40S split) to minimize $/token while meeting the latency SLO for chat, 2) committed pricing structure (monthly reserved vs upfront credits) and discount tiers you can offer. Also any perf/$ curves you can share to justify H100 for low-latency vs L40S for batch.

Happy to share workload traces if helpful. Can you send a short proposal and a couple of scheduling windows today?

Thanks,
Alex
CTO, ScaleWave
Phone: +1 415-555-0123
From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: Alex Chen <alex@scalewave.ai>, Priya Singh <priya@scalewave.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-18T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Dedicated - GPU mix/pricing for embeddings + low-latency chat

Alex — thanks for the clear ask. Short proposal attached (redwood_dedicated_pricing_v3.pdf) but summary below so we can slot a follow-up call quickly.

Recommendation (high level):
- Two-tier dedicated pool: H100s (low-latency tier) + L40S (batch/throughput tier). Avoid A100 unless you need mixed-precision legacy weights — H100 gives better perf/$ for small-batch chat due to improved kernel throughput; L40S is more cost-efficient for large-batch embedding runs.

Suggested split (starting point):
- H100: 8 GPUs (handles P99 ~80-120ms for chat at your projected concurrency); use single-GPU model variants or sharded KV cache as needed.
- L40S: 24 GPUs (optimized for 8–16k token batch jobs; continuous batching + KV cache warmers).

Commiting options and list economics:
- Monthly reserved commit (12-month): base list $/GPU-month for H100 and L40S in the attached.
- Upfront credits: 10% additional discount if they prepay 6+ months in advance.
- Performance credits: we offer a credit pool if latency SLOs miss (formula in PDF) — typically reduces net exposure and supports an aggressive discount.

Initial discount guidance from sales: we can do 15% off list for a 12-month commit at the volumes above, or 22% off list if customer prepays 6 months + signs a 12-month contract. These are draft numbers — Marissa (CC) will confirm approval thresholds.

Attachments: redwood_dedicated_pricing_v3.pdf (pricing table + perf assumptions). I've also attached a perf-dollar CSV to show measured throughput per-card for embedding batch sizes and chat latencies (perf-dollar-curve.csv).

Next steps: 1) quick 30-min call today (11:00–11:30 or 15:30–16:00 PT) to walk the numbers, 2) if that looks good we'll capture a tentative MA and I'll loop in billing for a formal quote.

-Jordan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-18T12:10:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: ScaleWave Dedicated - GPU mix/pricing for embeddings + low-latency chat

Marissa / Aditya — forwarding ScaleWave's ask + my proposal. Highlights: H100 for chat (8), L40S for batch (24). Proposed discounts: 15% (12m commit) or 22% (prepay 6m + 12m contract). They care about P99 ~120ms and heavy nightly batch volume.

Questions for you both:
- Marissa: can you confirm discount approval for 15% at our margin target? If they push, what's the max combined discount we can offer before Partner/Sales Ops approval?
- Aditya: can you validate the latency assumptions in the perf-dollar CSV for our current runtime (KV warming, continuous batching) and whether the H100 count is sufficient for the P99 at their expected concurrency?

I've attached the two artifacts I'm sending them. Will book the call once I have a green light on discount ranges.

-- Jordan
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-18T14:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: ScaleWave Dedicated - GPU mix/pricing for embeddings + low-latency chat

Jordan — thanks for the context. High-level approval:
- We can approve 15% off list for a 12-month committed pool (no prepay) at the proposed sizing (8 H100 / 24 L40S). That meets our baseline margin threshold.
- If ScaleWave prepays 6 months up front and signs 12 months total, approve up to 22% off list (bundle discount + prepay incentive).
- Include a performance-credit clause: if P99 latency for chat > 150ms for two consecutive weeks (after tuning window), issue a service credit equal to 5% of that month's committed spend. Documented in the pricing PDF.

Aditya — Jordan's perf-dollar CSV looked reasonable from a quick pass. I want a short follow-up from you (one paragraph) confirming H100 sizing for chat and any suggestions (model parallelism, lower-precision variants) that reduce H100 count without increasing latency risk.

Jordan — you have approval to propose the two discount tiers to ScaleWave. If they counter with deeper discount asks, escalate to me with the competitive win case.

-Marissa
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
